main_finding_one_sentence: Two-stage statistics + Logitboost achieved >95% detection and <1% false alarms for unseen web attacks on DARPA1999/ISCX2012.

metric_reported: detection rate (per-class accuracy); consistency across similar classes
main_finding_one_sentence: OSR + deep clustering separates zero-day classes from known classes and recommends similar known labels for unknown classes.

datasets: NSL-KDD; UNSW-NB15; CIC-IDS2017; CIC-DDoS2019; MalMem2022; ToN-IoT-Network; ToN-IoT-Linux; ISCXURL2016; CIC-Darknet2020; XIIoTID

main_finding_one_sentence: After attack classes were held out, supervised-model F1 dropped sharply; usfAD, a one-class classifier trained only on benign data, performed best on unseen attacks across 10 datasets.

main_finding_one_sentence: Before updating, the continual-learning agent usually detected zero-day classes at rates below 0.45; after updating, rates rose above 95%.

how_unseen_attacks_defined: No detection evaluation with held-out attack classes or a temporal split was performed; novelty is assessed through field/time-similarity comparisons of fingerprint signatures (99.05% similarity between FTP and SSH Patator), supporting the claim that signatures transfer to unseen attacks of the same type (§1, §4.2)

main_finding_one_sentence: Streaming outlier detection plus alert correlation generates fingerprint signatures and normalizes scores to the 0 to 1 range to harmonize thresholds across algorithms, yielding a 70-fold speedup.
